As Bank Of America Corporation (BAC) Share Value Declined, Atalanta Sosnoff Capital LLC Upped Its Holding by $5.03 Million
June 18, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.95 in 2018 Q1. Its down 0.24, from 1.19 in 2017Q4. It turned negative, as 73 investors sold BAC shares while 633 reduced holdings. 134 funds opened positions while 535 raised stakes. 6.66 billion shares or 2.67% less from 6.85 billion shares in 2017Q4 were reported. Suffolk Cap Management Limited Liability reported 292,634 shares. Wallington Asset Ltd Liability Corp stated it has 147,406 shares or 1.17% of all its holdings. Sumitomo Mitsui Hldg Inc has 29.54M shares. Next Financial Group Incorporated Inc has invested 0.4% in Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC). Atalanta Sosnoff Capital Llc increased its stake in Bank Of America Corporation (BAC) by 4.04% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Atalanta Sosnoff Capital Llc bought 173,437 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.97% with the market. The institutional investor held 4.47 million shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $133.91 million, up from 4.29 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Atalanta Sosnoff Capital Llc who had been investing in Bank Of America Corporation for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $293.43B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.16% or $0.34 during the last trading session, reaching $28.94. About 4.72 million shares traded. Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) has risen 29.72% since June 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 17.15% the S&P500.
Atalanta Sosnoff Capital Llc, which manages about $2.46B and $3.00B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Amazon Com Inc (NASDAQ:AMZN) by 4,399 shares to 97,379 shares, valued at $140.94M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 34,223 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 877,034 shares, and cut its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB).
